quantifier.name: FIXED_REPLANNING_ATTACK_POLICY_AND_ALL_ENEMY_AND_ALL_CHANCE
quantifier.rootAction: Incumbent and candidate retain their distinct root primitive.
quantifier.ownContinuation: One allocation-free replanning pursuit/turn/FIRE action per later PhysicalState.
quantifier.enemyContinuation: Complete generated enemy action domain at every expanded state.
quantifier.chanceContinuation: All stun and other generated chance outcomes.
quantifier.positiveMeaning: PROVEN is a sound witness for the full existential own-policy game.
quantifier.negativeMeaning: A fixed-policy refutation or strict frame-cap stop is UNKNOWN, never DISPROVEN for the full own-policy domain.

eventGoals.safeThreatFire: A newly emitted projectile survives or dooms the target while the committed incoming settlement is not doomed or unknown.
eventGoals.doomedTargetFire: A newly emitted projectile has a strict doomed-target settlement while the committed incoming settlement is safe and complete.

result.interpretation: Strict guaranteed-FIRE semantics cannot separate the two historical improvements from the two historical regressions. An adversarial enemy may refuse exposure; that refusal must be valued, not treated as a failed attack certificate.

retain: fixed one-action replanning policy as a bounded diagnostic
reject: BP139 as an action owner or veto
increasing depth to force a guaranteed FIRE certificate
treating enemy refusal to expose as attack failure
treating fixed-policy refutation as full-domain DISPROVEN
using local runtime as platform timeout evidence
decision.next: BP140 uses a finite-horizon lexicographic payoff/regret interval. Enemy responses that avoid FIRE remain valid columns but pay their measurable positional, terminal, star, contact and resource opportunity cost; no scalar ATTACK bonus regains ownership.
